Silhouette: Four-legged lion frame, four legs plus a separate pair of golden eagle wings. Host frame: the lion sets the outline, body size, and overall frame. A single creature that combines a lion and a golden eagle. Head of the golden eagle, fully visible and uncluttered, with clear, discernible eyes. Details: head: myth-style head swap. Golden eagle feathers in a few large patches over the forequarters and neck, at full strength with clean edges, color and surface unchanged inside each patch. Lion coat everywhere else. Behavior: follows the head donor. Plain coat, no stripes or spots. Four legs plus a separate pair of golden eagle wings on the shoulders. Wings held for display or gliding, not powered flight. Coat texture flows along the body outline. Declared fiction: six limbs (four legs plus wings), shown with wings rooted in a heavy shoulder structure that can carry them, not floating. Bilaterally symmetrical, recognizable limbs, visible sense organs. Habitat cue (forest): dark back and light belly (mild countershading). Prosaic detail: natural lighting, feet in firm contact with the ground with a soft shadow, normal wear on hooves, claws, and skin. One creature, full body, side three-quarter view, plain light background, natural history illustration.
Aspect ratio: 1:1.
